comment: Runtime payload manifest for OPEN RECODE (mobile coding).
No binaries are committed to this repository by design: Node.js publishes
no Android/arm64 build, so the runtime cannot be vendored and verified
without a physical device. Instead the app downloads these on first run
and verifies each against sha256 before use.
baseUrl: root URL these assets are fetched from. It is intentionally
EMPTY here because this repository does not host them. Either set it to
a release/CDN you control, or override it at runtime from the Control
Center ('Payload source'). Until then the app reports a precise
'not configured' state instead of failing cryptically.
To host a payload: put each file in a directory laid out as the 'path'
field below, record its real sha256, and point baseUrl at that directory.

assets.description: PRoot ARM64 static binary (rootless Linux syscall translator)
Minimal Linux rootfs (e.g. Alpine minirootfs aarch64); extracted by bootstrap.sh
Node.js runtime built for Android arm64; must unpack to node/bin/node
